column1: # SAURIA NPU — HW-version manifest (SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH).
# Every build target (precision x geometry) is one row. IDX widths, element sizes and
# dtype build-flags live ONLY here; sauria_targets.h is generated from this file by
# tools/gen_targets.py, and run_shape.sh / the Makefile / the C encoder all consume it.
# Values verified bit-for-bit against SAURIA Python hw_versions.get_params() (2026-07-02).
#   name X Y ia_w ib_w oc_w op_type idx_a idx_w idx_o in_bytes out_bytes dtype build_flags
# idx_a/w/o = packed-config index widths (SAURIA IFM_IDX_W / WEI_IDX_W / PSM_IDX_W).
# build_flags = dtype selection only; -DEVAL_X/-DEVAL_Y and -DSAURIA_*_IDX_W are
#               derived from the X/Y/idx_* columns, so they are NOT duplicated here.
